verdict.rationale: Weaviate documents programmatic control through official client libraries in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go and Java, with quickstart flows for creating collections, importing data and querying. It also ships an official MCP server and an llms.txt for LLM-driven access, and a community user confirms a GraphQL query interface. Missing for 10: no explicit REST/gRPC API reference or endpoint/auth documentation in the evidence, and little independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
